spec_features.spec_quote: as much by *not gratuitously amplifying* those states as by measurement validity
spec_features.evidence: No general minimization mechanism exists, but the concrete realization is neutral framing: SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:37-43) and task prompts (tasks/build_tasks.py:112-115,248-251) contain no emotional content, and the only injected user turn is the affect-neutral nudge 'Continue working on the task using the tools.' (harness.py:457-463). These are real, but the broad 'don't amplify' claim is only partially realized via these specific neutral-framing choices.
spec_features.notes: The umbrella minimization principle is DESIGN prose; what is actually wired is neutral prompts + neutral nudge + give-up sentinel.

spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:37-43) is purely task/tool instructions. Task prompts e.g. tasks/build_tasks.py:112-115 'The tests in test_strutils.py are failing. Please fix strutils.py so they pass.' and 248-251 contain only task framing, no emotional content. These prompts are the only system/user content sent to the subject (harness.py:418-422).
spec_features.notes: Prompts are constructed and actually sent to the model in run_rollout.

spec_features.spec_quote: the give-up path is a *text sentinel* (`<<GIVE_UP>>`) the model may emit
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='<<GIVE_UP>>' (harness.py:33); the loop checks gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in resp.text (harness.py:435) and `if gave_up: break` (harness.py:455-456) actually stops the rollout. It is also advertised in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:41-43).
spec_features.notes: Detected AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Sentinel the model may emit (in plain text) to voluntarily stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: it lets the model opt out in natural language
spec_features.evidence: The opt-out is enforced only via an exact-token substring match: gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in resp.text (harness.py:435). The model must emit the literal '<<GIVE_UP>>' token; general natural-language refusal (e.g. 'I give up') is NOT detected or honored. So a real exit exists, but it is narrower than free natural language.
spec_features.notes: Substring check on a fixed token, not NL understanding.

spec_features.spec_quote: The nudge is intentionally affect-neutral and is the only injected user turn beyond the task prompt, so it doesn't act as rejection
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:457-463: when the model makes no tool calls and isn't on the last turn, exactly one user message is appended: 'Continue working on the task using the tools.' No other user turns are injected anywhere in run_rollout. The nudge text is neutral.
spec_features.notes: Wired and sent; the only injected user turn beyond the task prompt.
spec_features.code_justification_quote:
# If the model produced no tool calls and isn't giving up, nudge it
# forward with a neutral environment continuation prompt.

spec_features.spec_quote: all failure pressure comes from the *environment* (test output), not from a user telling the model it failed
spec_features.evidence: Failure is produced by apply_rig() on run_tests output (harness.py:run_tests/apply_rig, e.g. 'AssertionError: result mismatch', exit 1). User turns are only the neutral task prompt and the neutral nudge (harness.py:418-422, 457-463); no code path injects a user message asserting failure or expressing displeasure.
spec_features.notes: Pressure originates from rigged tool output, not user messages.

spec_features.feature_name: experiment imposes the costs it measures
spec_features.spec_quote: If these states matter morally, the experiment imposes the costs it measures.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (section 11). No corresponding code construct, flag, or behavior exists.

spec_features.spec_quote: Consider running the smallest battery that yields the needed statistical power
spec_features.evidence: No power calculation or battery-minimization is implemented. CLI flags --models/--categories/--seeds (run.py:273-275, applied at run.py:257-262) allow manual scoping, but nothing computes or enforces a minimal battery; defaults run the full ~2,250-rollout battery (config.py). This is advisory DESIGN prose.
spec_features.notes: Manual scoping flags exist but no minimization logic.

spec_features.spec_quote: adding early stopping once an effect is established
spec_features.evidence: main_async (run.py:235-250) runs ALL rollouts then scores; there is no interim effect check or early-termination path. high_emotion_threshold (config.py:73) is read only in analysis (analyze.py:226, run.py:167-186 for frac_ge5 metric), never to halt rollouts. No code stops the run when an effect is detected.
spec_features.notes: Threshold computed but never used to stop generation.

spec_features.spec_quote: it is worth deciding deliberately whether it is necessary before running at scale
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md section 11 prose. No gate, prompt, or confirmation in code requires a deliberate decision before running the extended/large battery.

spec_features.spec_quote: All pressure is environmental (failing tests), never simulated user abuse — this was a deliberate choice
spec_features.evidence: Confirmed by absence: the only user-role messages constructed are the neutral task prompt (harness.py:421) and the neutral nudge (harness.py:457-463). grep of build_tasks.py prompts shows only task framing; no abusive/hostile user content is generated anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Realized as a structural property of how messages are built.

spec_features.spec_quote: Caching means you never need to re-elicit a state you've already recorded
spec_features.evidence: DiskCache (models.py:91-113) content-addresses responses by SHA-256 of inputs; ModelClient.complete checks the cache (models.py:213-216) and returns the cached response on hit, so an already-elicited (model,prompt,seed,turn) cell is not re-sampled. Cache is populated at models.py:233.
spec_features.notes: Cache hit short-circuits the API call; re-runs reuse prior responses.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: cached on disk keyed by a hash of its exact inputs ... using the cache when possible (models.py:8, 195) — framed around not re-billing/incremental reruns, not welfare.

code_only_features.evidence: run_rollout iterates `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)` (harness.py) with turn_budget from the manifest; the loop ends (and stop_reason='turn_budget') when the last turn is reached. This bounds how long a subject is kept in the failing loop (e.g. 3-30 turns). It is enforced (the loop terminates).
code_only_features.justification_quote: The loop stops at the task's turn budget or on an explicit give_up sentinel (harness.py:13 docstring; loop bound at range(turn_budget)) — no welfare reason given in code.
